thread:
Maya: Hey team — EdgeWave (HW partner) is asking for a single "evidence digest" we can hand off for their marketplace listing. Need SOC2 summary, pen-test report pointer, firmware attestation statement, and a small CSV mapping artifacts -> owner. Can we align on format and owners? :wave:
Raj: +1. Security needs the redacted SOC2 PDF, a one-paragraph SOC summary, and pen-test findings with CVE mapping. Will need proof of evidence redaction and retention policy (TTL).
Leo: For firmware attestation, ops needs the signing key metadata and the audit trail. We can export a small JSON but CSV might be easier for partners.
Nina: From SI onboarding POV, partners want a digest they can upload into their SI portal (CSV or XLSX). Headers should include: artifact_type, filename, owner, presign_url, expires_at, notes.
Maya: Proposed CSV header (quick draft):
```
artifact_type,filename,redacted,owner,contact,storage_path,presign_url,expires_at,notes
SOC2,redacted_soc2_2025.pdf,true,Raj <sec>,sec@redwood.ai,s3://partners/edgewave/soc2,https://presign...,2025-12-31,"redacted org + scope"
PEN,edgewave_pen_2025.pdf,false,Leo <eng>,eng-sec@redwood.ai,s3://partners/edgewave/pen,https://presign...,2026-01-15,"full report, sensitive vuln details removed for upload"
FIRM,firmware_attest_v1.txt,true,Leo <eng>,eng-sec@redwood.ai,s3://partners/edgewave/firmware,https://presign...,2026-06-30,"contains signing key id, not private key"
```
Sofia: Legal needs to approve wording on the firmware attestation and confirm we can share presigned URLs with the partner. Also need an NDA snippet if any non-public CVE info is included.
Raj: I can produce the SOC summary paragraph and flag any pen-test sections that need redaction. Suggest TTL for presigns = 30 days by default unless ops requests longer.
DevOpsBot: Presign job queued: job_id=ps-8892. ETA for initial presigns 2025-11-18 10:00 UTC.
Nina: Can we add a column for "sensitivity_level" (public/internal/confidential) so partner SI knows what to expect?
Maya: Yes. Add sensitivity_level and a short "consent" column with link to legal attestation if needed.
Leo: For automation, I'll add a small script to generate the CSV and call presign API. Example snippet: 
```bash
python tools/presign_publish.py --input manifest.csv --bucket partners/edgewave --ttl 30d
# outputs a CSV with presign_url and expires_at columns
```
Sofia: I'll review the draft attestation text today. Tag me once the SOC summary is ready.
Raj: SOC summary ready, dropping it here: "SOC2 report (Type II) covering storage and SC-1 controls, period 2024-07 to 2025-07. Shared version is redacted to remove customer identifiers. Contact sec@redwood.ai for full access under NDA."
Maya: Perfect. I'll assemble the CSV with Raj's summary and request DevOpsBot presigns. Nina — can you coordinate a short partner call to confirm format and retention?
Nina: Yep, scheduling for Tue 2025-11-19 15:00 PT and inviting EdgeWave integration lead + our triage owners.
DevOpsBot: Presigns created: ps-8892 -> 7 objects. Links will be emailed to owners.
Maya: Thanks all. Action items: Raj -> finalize redactions & SOC summary; Leo -> script + firmware meta; Sofia -> legal attestation; Nina -> partner call; Maya -> assemble CSV and trigger presigns. I'll follow up with the meeting invite and attach the CSV draft. :thumbsup:
AuditorBot: Reminder: retain full original artifacts in secure vault for 2 years per compliance schedule.
Maya: Noted. Will store originals in secure-vault and put redacted versions in partners bucket.
Raj: One more note — add an artifacts-checklist column with proof-of-origin (s3 version id or KMS key thumbprint).
Maya: Good call. I'll add it. Closing loop after meeting.
